package.description: The Human NIBP Device Enabler allows the Human NIBP Controller and Nano Core Systems to stream non-invasive blood pressure data directly into LabChart.

en-US.description: The Human NIBP Device Enabler allows the Human NIBP Controller and Nano Core Systems to stream non-invasive blood pressure data directly into LabChart.
en-US.longDescription: The Human NIBP Device Enabler allows the Human NIBP Controller and Nano Core Systems to stream non-invasive blood pressure data directly into LabChart. The Human NIBP Systems are based on Finapres modules and allow switching between two fingers, permitting prolonged blood pressure measurements with minimal discomfort.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Human NIBP

zh-CN.description: Human NIBP 设备启用器支持将 Human NIBP 控制器和 Nano 核心系统的无创血压数据直接传输至 LabChart。
zh-CN.longDescription: Human NIBP 设备启用器支持将 Human NIBP 控制器和 Nano 核心系统的无创血压数据直接传输至 LabChart。该血压监测系统基于 Finapres 模块技术，可实现双指轮换测量，在确保长时间血压监测的同时最大限度减少受试者不适感。
